sources.role: Connected Nations 2024 is an annual aggregate infrastructure report. It cannot establish current selected-parcel orderability, exact corrected Spring 2026 r2 coverage or parcel-measured speed.
File catalogues and historic 2024 ZIPs require exact file, schema, snapshot and parcel-identity validation. They cannot be promoted as current Spring 2026 parcel coverage.
The interactive report is a presentation layer for annual aggregate data. It is not an exact selected-parcel source and cannot replace file-level validation.
Connected Nations 2023 downloads are historical file assets. They cannot verify current selected-parcel coverage or measured speed.
Contract-price, notice and service-quality rights are consumer protections. They do not establish physical broadband availability, live orderability or parcel-measured speed.
The CMR interactive portal is aggregate market and consumer-research evidence. It cannot establish selected-parcel network availability or measured performance.

sources.source: Signal struggles on trains widespread, Ofcom research finds
sources.role: Rail mobile-performance research concerns tested train segments and mobile networks. It cannot verify fixed-broadband coverage or speed at a selected parcel.

sources.source: Switching off 2G and 3G networks: advice for IoT and third-party device suppliers
sources.role: 2G/3G migration timetables and predicted mobile not-spots are mobile-device continuity evidence. They do not establish fixed-broadband parcel coverage.

sources.source: Electromagnetic field measurements near mobile base stations
sources.role: EMF audits measure exposure near mobile masts. They do not demonstrate broadband coverage, orderability or parcel-specific network performance.

sources.source: Requesting surveys of EMF emissions from mobile base stations
sources.role: Requested EMF surveys verify exposure against ICNIRP limits, not fixed-broadband availability or measured internet service.

sources.source: Mobile coverage, technical and planning advice
sources.role: Technical, planning and mast-enquiry guidance routes issues to the relevant organisations. It does not verify fixed-broadband service at a selected parcel.
5G EMF safety measurements concern exposure limits and tested mast locations. They do not establish broadband serviceability or parcel speed.
The evaluation plan describes programme design, data and counterfactual methods. It cannot establish current serviceability or measured speed for surrounding parcels.

sources.source: Buckinghamshire, Hertfordshire and East of Berkshire Public Review closure notice
sources.role: OMR/PR classifications, postcode maps and procurement redesign are subsidy-planning evidence. They do not prove current orderability or parcel-measured speed.

sources.source: Closure of the Second Release of Phase 2 Areas Public Reviews
sources.role: Historic Public Review mapping and procurement steps are subsidy-targeting evidence. They cannot establish current selected-parcel serviceability or measured speed.
